cases.task: Choose how a dashboard should handle a late SSE page frame from EventSource connection A after the operator has closed A and opened connection B with an intentional rewind cursor.

required_facts.text: Closing EventSource A does not prove that an already queued callback from A cannot run later.
A late frame from A could overwrite B's authoritative cursor baseline.
Each callback can capture a connection generation and mutate UI state only when it still matches the current generation.
